records.description: A spacious, white developer-platform landing page uses a restrained black-and-gray type system with Supabase green reserved for actions and emphasis. The page moves from a compact announcement and navigation into a two-column hero, then a dense six-card capability grid, proof logos, product UI demonstrations, code and templates, customer stories, community posts, open-source messaging, a repeated CTA, and a highly structured footer. Thin borders, very soft shadows, modest corner radii, grayscale product imagery, and a single vivid gradient story card create contrast without changing the overall minimal rhythm.

records.name: Supabase Open Graph social card by supabase.com
records.description: A 1200×630 dark card built on a single centered axis with almost no furniture: a near-black #1c1c1c canvas, the glyph-plus-wordmark lockup sitting in the upper third, and a stacked two-line headline filling the middle. The only hierarchy device is colour — line one of the headline is white while line two flips to the brand green (#3ECF8E), making the tagline pair read as a call-and-response. Roughly half the canvas is empty, which lets the heavy geometric sans headline dominate even at small preview sizes; there are no gradients, shadows, screenshots or decoration of any kind.

records.name: Superhuman platform landing page by superhuman.com
records.description: A long-form productivity-suite landing page alternates a sparse off-white canvas with dense product showcases, using centered headlines, compact eyebrow labels, and purple primary actions to establish hierarchy. The page develops from a dark split hero into logo proof, an AI assistant feature grid, testimonial, Mail and Docs product sections, an enterprise band, a photographic-gradient CTA, and a maroon multi-column footer; rounded media cards, subtle borders, and blurred interface imagery provide visual continuity while section backgrounds reset the rhythm.

records.name: Superhuman OG card — gradient split with floating AI card by superhuman.com
records.description: A 1200×630 social card built on a 55/45 split: the left half is a saturated crimson-to-indigo gradient field carrying a white rounded app icon, an oversized letterspaced uppercase wordmark and a light two-line subhead, all clustered on the vertical centre line; the right half is a product screenshot that bleeds off the top and right edges, giving the flat canvas depth. Hierarchy reads icon → wordmark → subhead on the left, while the floating AI popover card — with its red diff text '14 months. 16 months.' — is the focal detail on the right. The palette is strictly three-tone (brand red, deep blue, white), with the screenshot rendered at believable small type sizes so the UI reads as real software rather than an illustration.

records.name: Sweetgreen restaurant homepage by sweetgreen.com
records.description: The page builds identity through full-width colour blocks that shift from a deep berry gradient hero through cream, sage and tan bands, each change of ground resetting the rhythm. A high-contrast serif carries every display headline while an uppercase grotesk handles eyebrows, nav and buttons, with a single acid-lime accent reserved almost exclusively for the primary CTA. Menu exploration is a clean three-column grid of top-down bowl photography with serif category tabs, and the lower page alternates split editorial sections (text left, warm photography right) before settling into a utilitarian newsletter strip and link-column footer.

records.name: Tailwind CSS landing page by tailwindcss.com
records.description: A long developer-tool landing page that pairs an airy white editorial layout with dark, editor-styled code panels as the hero visual and throughout the feature bento grid. The page builds trust with a dense sponsor logo wall, then shifts rhythm into a playful, illustrated bento of feature cards each containing a live UI demo (responsive cards, dark-mode banking widget, colour palettes, easing curves). Small monospace eyebrow labels, a giant tight-tracked grotesque headline, and pink/teal utility-class highlights in body copy carry the product's own identity into the design.

records.name: Tailwind CSS 4.3 release social card by tailwindcss.com
records.description: Tailwind's 1200×630 share card reads like an engineering blueprint: the 4.3 release number is extruded as a thin white isometric wireframe with 45°-hatched top faces, floating over a near-black canvas with a faint perspective grid and crosshair ticks. A dense monospace spec panel top-right (title, build channel, language percentages, oversized 4.3 numeral) balances the airy centre, while the cyan wave-mark plus lowercase wordmark anchor bottom-left and a tiny x/y/z axis sketch closes bottom-right. Flat line art, a single sky-blue accent and a huge density contrast between the data table and the empty field carry the whole composition.

records.name: Tally form builder landing page by tally.so
records.description: A very long, airy landing page uses a white canvas, heavy black sans-serif headings, and bright magenta annotation marks to make a no-code form builder feel approachable rather than technical. The hero is sparse and centered around a large product preview, then the page settles into a repeated rhythm of left-aligned section headings, hand-drawn decorative artwork, bordered screenshot cards, compact feature grids, testimonials, and increasingly practical sections for sharing, integrations, templates, and FAQs. Thin gray borders, faint shadows, small corner radii, and restrained blue CTA buttons keep the dense lower content legible while the sketch-like illustrations add movement and personality.

records.name: Teenage Engineering homepage — alternating dark cinematic and white catalog product showcase by teenage.engineering
records.description: A stark Swiss-catalogue homepage built on a strict alternation: hairline-divided white product-card rows (three columns, 1px black borders, tiny lowercase 'buy now' links) punctuate full-bleed near-black cinematic product photography with captions pinned bottom-left. Type lives at two extremes — a 9–10px utilitarian sans for every nav item, label and link, and a viewport-wide ultra-condensed all-caps headline for the hero. One orange-red accent is rationed across the promo flag, 'buy now' affordances and a single object detail per section, while a hand-made RIDDIM collage breaks the grid midway with cut-paper textures and mixed lettering to reset the rhythm before the pattern resumes.

records.name: teenage.engineering product lineup OG card by teenage.engineering
records.description: A near-black 1200×630 social card where hierarchy is built entirely with light instead of type: a wide instrument sits front and centre as the focal point, three smaller devices are staggered behind it for depth, and the outer third of the frame is pure darkness. There is no headline or wordmark anywhere — the only text is tiny model designations engraved on the hardware, which does the branding work. The palette is strictly monochrome (matte black bodies, white and silver details) with a single micro red LED accent, and a soft overhead spotlight with heavy vignetting gives the whole card a studio-stage mood.

records.name: Termsquad cloud computer landing page by termsquad.com
records.description: A dark, highly structured infrastructure landing page uses oversized white and muted-gray headlines, thin borders, and restrained green status accents to frame product UI demonstrations. After the hero, the page moves through increasingly concrete proof: persistent-session and agent-squad diagrams, shared-memory messaging, a four-card capability grid, pricing, FAQ, and a green-tinted final CTA; generous vertical gaps separate sections while bordered panels create denser focal areas.

records.name: TermSquad Open Graph social card by termsquad.com
records.description: A 1200×630 dark social card split roughly 55/45: the left column carries the wordmark, a three-line headline in a large humanist sans ("for AI agents." highlighted in pale green), a muted supporting sentence and a "Works with" icon row; the right half shows a mocked terminal/browser window with traffic-light dots and an agent conversation log in monospace, using green checks and role labels (Orchestrator / Implementer / Reviewer). The near-black background has faint diagonal light streaks, and the single green accent ties logo, headline emphasis and terminal statuses together, making the product's multi-agent concept legible at a glance.

records.name: Thousand — Git-backed docs landing page by Thousand
records.description: A warm cream-and-yellow developer-tools landing page that alternates large serif-feeling headlines with dense, highly believable product mockups (file trees, comment threads, terminal output, spreadsheets). The rhythm alternates wide two-column feature rows with stacked bento cards, punctuated by full-width accent blocks (yellow "Decks and PDFs" band, near-black "no lock-in" section, and a huge yellow closing CTA). Highlights, dotted-underline annotations, and commit-style metadata give the page a distinctive "documents with editorial markup" character.

records.name: Thousand OG card — brand lockup on cream by Thousand
records.description: A brand-only Open Graph card at roughly 1200×630: one centered lockup — a rounded bracket glyph cradling three pill bars, the longest in amber, beside the wordmark set in an extra-bold rounded sans — floating in a warm cream field with no headline, tagline or URL. Hierarchy comes entirely from the single accent bar and the matching scale of glyph and type; roughly two-thirds of the canvas is empty. Flat fills, a consistent pill radius across glyph and bars, and tight tracking on the heavy type keep it legible even at small share-preview sizes.

records.name: Together AI platform landing page by together.ai
records.description: A polished AI infrastructure landing page moves from a pale blue, split hero with oversized black-and-gray typography and a colorful abstract 3D composition into progressively denser product proof. The white middle sections use centered headings, pastel metric cards, tabbed capability panels, and restrained rules; a full-width near-black research section creates the main contrast break with compact editorial cards. Below that, generous whitespace frames customer stories, a structured blog grid, and a pale-blue CTA that resolves into a large rounded white mega-footer over soft abstract color fields.

records.name: together.ai OG social card — gradient cloud hero by together.ai
records.description: A 1200×630 social card that treats its background as light rather than imagery: a hazy sky-blue gradient wash fills the canvas, with a soft blurred 3D curve occupying the right half and a single thin diagonal light streak cutting across it. All content is stacked in one left column — a compact logo lockup (three overlapping lavender, magenta and orange dots beside a black lowercase wordmark) sitting above a two-line headline where the first line is heavy near-black and the second drops to a lighter gray at the same size. The bottom third stays completely empty, which keeps the card legible at thumbnail scale and gives the composition its airy, unhurried rhythm.

records.name: Trigger.dev developer platform landing page by trigger.dev
records.description: A long-form dark landing page built on a near-black canvas with a single disciplined lime-green accent for primary actions, plus rotating per-feature hues (green, pink, blue, purple) on eyebrows, icons and status pills. Credibility comes from real artefacts everywhere: syntax-highlighted code editors, live-looking product UI mockups (task queues, filters, charts), node-flow diagrams and a video walkthrough instead of stock illustration. Rhythm shifts deliberately down the page — airy centred hero, dense two-column code demo, alternating feature rows, a three-column mega-list at peak density, then a masonry testimonial wall, stat row and a compact CTA before the link-column footer.

records.name: Trigger.dev dark OG social card by trigger.dev
records.description: A 1200×630 dark social card that leans on a single rotated, blurred screenshot of the product's run-timeline UI for texture and credibility without competing with the message. The lockup sits top-left — a green triangle mark beside 'Trigger' in green and '.dev' in violet — while a two-line, ~72px white headline in a bold geometric sans is pinned to the bottom-left safe zone. A diagonal depth-of-field blur plus a dark gradient scrim keep the striped duration bars, blue highlight bar and status dots strictly atmospheric, so high contrast exists only where text sits.

records.name: Obra construction cost tracking landing page by tryobra.com
records.description: A long-form product landing page for construction cost tracking uses a near-black canvas, cream data panels, and a vivid orange accent to create a high-contrast editorial system. Oversized condensed headlines alternate solid and outlined words; the page moves from an energetic hero and statistic into receipt workflows, ledger tables, dashboard charts, feature grids, a public project proof section, calculator, pricing, FAQ, lead capture, and a large orange closing CTA, with thin rules and compact monospace annotations keeping the dense content ordered.

records.name: Obra dark OG social card by tryobra.com
records.description: A 1200×630 dark social card built almost entirely from typography: a bold three-line headline mixes solid off-white, stroke-only outline text and orange emphasis words to create hierarchy within a single display face. Decorative concentric charcoal circles bleed off the right edge to balance the left-aligned text block, while the bottom row pairs monospace supporting copy on the left with a filled orange CTA and an outlined URL button on the right. The palette is strict — near-black, warm off-white, one saturated orange, one gray — and everything is flat, with no shadows or gradients outside the logo mark.

records.name: Turso landing page by turso.tech
records.description: A dark, near-black developer landing page built almost entirely from typography, terminal-style code windows and thin-bordered cards, with a single teal/mint accent used sparingly for CTAs, links and one glowing illustration. The hero pairs a bold statement headline with a live code snippet, then the page alternates rhythm: a manifesto section with a diagram, a five-column numbered property grid, code demo, customer stories in bordered cards, enterprise compliance, a two-path open-source/cloud split, a community section with pill-labelled cards, and a CTA closed by a playful green database illustration. The restraint is the point: no stock photos, no gradients (except the final illustration), density controlled by generous whitespace and consistent hairline card borders.

records.name: Turso Open Graph social card by turso.tech
records.description: A 1200×630 share card built on a single centred axis: a small mint mascot-plus-wordmark lockup sits at the top, and a three-line stacked headline fills the middle with two key words picked out in mint green against a near-black navy field. The type is an extremely heavy geometric sans at roughly 110px with tight line-height, so the card stays legible at thumbnail size. Everything else is suppressed — no URL, buttons or imagery — letting the negative space make the two-colour headline the entire message.

records.name: Typewise Nova AI customer experience platform landing page by Typewise Nova
records.description: A long-form dark SaaS landing page uses a near-black canvas, cool blue-violet glows, and large centered typography to establish the product promise before progressively introducing proof, workflows, product UI, comparison content, audience paths, testimonials, FAQs, and conversion points. The rhythm alternates between spacious centered headlines and dense bordered interface panels, with blue reserved for emphasis and actions while muted gray text and thin outlines keep the page controlled.

records.name: Typewise OG social card by Typewise Nova
records.description: A 1200×630 dark social card built almost entirely from negative space: a near-black canvas, a compact logo lockup in the top-left, and a two-line white headline filling the lower-left third. Two thin, glowing blue arcs sweep through the top-right and bottom-left corners, creating diagonal energy that frames the type without competing with it. Hierarchy is carried purely by scale — a ~40px wordmark against a ~95px headline — with one electric blue accent repeated in the logo badge and the luminous swooshes.

records.name: Uber consumer landing page by uber.com
records.description: Uber's homepage is a black-and-white utility page where a working booking widget sits directly in the hero beside a saturated illustration. Below, alternating text/illustration blocks, a teal highlight panel, a three-by-two service card grid, and a dark app-download and footer section keep a strict left-aligned type rhythm; flat editorial illustrations carry all the colour so the product UI itself stays monochrome.

records.name: Uini customer insight and help widget landing page by uini.io
records.description: A spacious, mostly white SaaS landing page uses oversized black and rust-orange headlines, restrained gray body copy, and generous vertical gaps to establish a calm editorial rhythm. The page moves from a centered hero and browser mockup into three concise benefit columns, then alternating text-and-product-demo sections; dense pricing, testimonial cards, FAQ rows, and a bright orange CTA/footer close the experience, while small pixel-art accents provide a distinctive low-fi visual motif.

records.name: uini.io Open Graph social card by uini.io
records.description: A 1200×630 social card split into a white brand panel and a cream product vignette. The left half stacks a squircle logo, a three-line headline with one word flipped to coral orange, a numbered three-step chip row and a black pill CTA; the right half runs a top-to-bottom pipeline of floating UI cards — behaviour trigger, chat interview, dual insights — tied together by dotted connectors with uppercase orange micro-labels. Soft diffuse shadows, generous radii and cropped beige circles keep it friendly, while the two-tone headline and tiny pipeline type carry the hierarchy.

records.name: Upstash landing page by upstash.com
records.description: A serverless-data-platform landing page built on a mint-to-green gradient canvas with oversized display typography that shifts from gradient-filled hero text to a full-bleed 'Fast Anywhere' band over a dotted globe. The page alternates airy white rounded cards and dark terminal blocks, using a bento grid for the platform section, numbered feature columns inside the product panel, big green stat numerals, a script-type testimonial with a lozenge logo wall, and a minimal centered footer. Density rises in the middle (code, pricing boxes, diagrams) and relaxes again toward community and footer, giving the long page a clear light–dense–social rhythm.

records.name: Upstash Serverless Data Platform OG image by upstash.com
records.description: A 1200×630 social card on a near-black canvas with a subtle dark-green vignette glow. A single massive white two-line headline ("Serverless / Data Platform") dominates the top two-thirds, with a row of rounded dark pill badges beneath showing five product logos and names in per-product accent colours (red, orange, blue, purple, green). A green underlined domain link with a playful cursor graphic anchors the bottom. Hierarchy is strictly vertical and centered: headline → product pills → URL, with generous negative space keeping it legible at thumbnail size.

records.name: v0.dev AI app builder landing page by v0.dev
records.description: A near-monochrome landing page where the UI chrome is deliberately quiet — off-white canvas, black type, hairline gray borders — so the only saturated color arrives inside community template thumbnails and feature vignettes. The hero is a single centered prompt bar with suggestion chips, making the product itself the headline. Down the page, density rises through a three-column template gallery with fork/like metadata and a deliberately clipped final row, peaks in a nine-cell bento where each feature card carries its own illustrative miniature (icon clusters, a node diagram, a phone mockup), then relaxes through a grayscale logo marquee and a horizontal rail of tall mobile screenshots into a very airy centered CTA and four-column footer.

records.name: v0 Open Graph social card by v0.dev
records.description: A 1200×630 Open Graph card built almost entirely from negative space: a near-black canvas, a small white wordmark anchored top-left, and one large headline — 'Think it. Build it. Ship it.' — floating slightly left of the optical center. The only other mark is a thin vertical text caret after the last word, which quietly signals the product's chat-driven, generative nature. Type does all the work: a geometric neo-grotesque at roughly 80px medium weight against a tiny wordmark creates an extreme scale contrast, and pure monochrome (black #000, white #fff) guarantees legibility even at thumbnail size.

records.name: Venmo consumer homepage by venmo.com
records.description: Venmo's consumer landing page alternates airy, typography-led white sections with saturated full-bleed colour bands — a rounded sky-blue hero card, an indigo rewards band, an orange-to-yellow gradient business card, and a blue app-download band — each carrying exactly one message. Hierarchy is driven by an oversized bold grotesque with tight tracking, pill-shaped CTAs that flip from black-on-white to white-on-colour, and huge vertical padding between the two-column Debit/Credit/Checkout rows. Superscript footnote markers thread through the marketing copy and balloon into a dense regulatory footer, a signature fintech pattern; ghosted statement headlines ('Send. Split. Gift.', 'Purchase crypto') act as scroll-paced interstitials between the colour bands.

records.name: Venmo Open Graph social card by venmo.com
records.description: A 1200×630 social card built on a white canvas with a hard asymmetric split: the left column stacks a small bold 'Homepage' eyebrow over an oversized two-line headline in a heavy, tightly-tracked grotesque, while the right half is a large rounded-corner photo of two people at a tailgate. Two white pill-shaped payment chips with circular avatars float over the photo ('Wes paid', 'Leona for Game Day'), and a slice of brand-blue logo geometry bleeds in behind the subjects. Scale contrast between eyebrow, display headline and chip labels, plus the flat-white-to-warm-photo division, keeps the card legible even at feed-thumbnail size.

records.name: Vercel homepage — Agentic Infrastructure hero by vercel.com
records.description: A radically minimal monochrome landing page built almost entirely from typography and one flat black triangle. The hero uses an asymmetric three-part grid: a huge two-line display headline (~110px, tight leading) on the left, the giant geometric brand shape centered, and a small stack of three short value lines on the right. Hierarchy is achieved purely through scale contrast — a compact 14–16px nav and banner, one enormous headline, everything on a white field with near-black text. Fully rounded pill CTAs (solid black and outlined white), an announcement strip above the nav, and a customer wordmark marquee cropped at the fold set the rhythm for the rest of the page.

records.name: Dark Vercel social card by vercel.com
records.description: A 1200×630 social card uses an almost-black canvas with a centered, oversized black triangular mark as the sole focal point. A restrained gray-white halo separates the geometric silhouette from the background, while the absence of headline, wordmark, and supporting copy creates a stark, highly recognizable composition with extreme negative space.

records.name: Viso AI landing page by Viso Now
records.description: A computer-vision platform page that opens with a full-bleed dark aerial photo and a glassmorphic prompt-to-build input, then settles into an airy white editorial rhythm: pink-dot uppercase eyebrows, oversized grotesque headings, and photo-led card grids for templates and stories. The accent system is disciplined — one magenta for dots, checks and CTAs, one purple reserved for the enterprise tier — while hierarchy swings between dense 4-column photo grids, a white-vs-black dual product split, and giant 54%/24/7/10×/90% numerals. The page closes dark: a purple-gradient CTA panel and a black multi-column footer with certification badges.

records.name: Viso Now announcement social card by Viso Now
records.description: A 1200×630 announcement card built as a split canvas: the left half is a white typographic column (letterspaced eyebrow with a pink dot, a two-tone headline whose second line flips to pink, a gray two-line subline, and the wordmark pinned bottom-left), while the right half is a pale gray stage holding one dark floating prompt card. Hierarchy comes entirely from weight and colour — a single geometric sans steps from ~20px letterspaced caps to a ~68px bold headline — and the pink accent is rationed to four points (eyebrow dot, headline phrase, text caret, submit button) so the mock prompt card reads as product proof rather than decoration. The card's 24px radius and soft shadow lift it off the flat panels without any gradient or illustration.

records.name: Warp cloud software factories landing page by warp.dev
records.description: A full-length developer-platform landing page uses a strict column grid, faint vertical rules, compact monospace typography, and mostly white space to make dense technical content feel organized. The hero establishes the system with a large typewriter-style headline and pale terminal mockup, then the page alternates feature lists, data dashboards, case studies, enterprise cards, layered diagrams, product tiles, and FAQ rows; saturated electric blue-purple appears mainly as a high-contrast case-study band and selected diagram states.

records.name: Warp OG social card — orbiting illustration collage on a dark blueprint grid by warp.dev
records.description: A 1200×630 social card that treats itself like a dark design board: a near-black field with faint hairline gridlines, plus-mark intersections and dashed centre guides, over which twelve rounded tiles are scattered in a loose elliptical orbit around a single white logo glyph. Each tile holds a different vintage night-sky illustration — aurora curtains, comets, rain, sepia clouds — in muted teal, indigo, charcoal and beige, so the collage reads as a deck of slides pinned to a canvas. There is no headline at all; hierarchy comes entirely from the bright central mark against the dim grid, with tile size and hue variation supplying the rhythm.

records.name: Wealthfolio personal finance landing page by Wealthfolio
records.description: A warm off-white, editorial landing page pairs large high-contrast serif headlines with compact monospace supporting text and restrained black controls. The page starts with a spacious hero and layered desktop/mobile product mockup, then moves through denser feature cards, local-data diagrams, pricing, community proof, deployment options, add-ons, and a quiet final CTA; pale beige section shifts and thin rules provide rhythm without strong colour blocks.

records.name: Wealthfolio OG social card by Wealthfolio
records.description: A 1200×630 social card split roughly 55/45 between a text column and a product-mockup cluster on a warm cream gradient. The left column stacks the wordmark, a two-line serif headline that flips to italic on the second line for cadence, a gray sans subhead where two key words sit inside yellow marker-style highlights, and a dot-separated trust line. The right half shows a simplified desktop dashboard (big net-worth figure, olive-green area chart, green/red account rows) overlapped by an iPhone frame running the same UI, cropped by the canvas edge. The palette stays disciplined — cream, charcoal-olive ink, one yellow accent — so the single highlight gesture and the chart green do all the accent work.

records.name: Wealthfront homepage — APY-led fintech landing page by wealthfront.com
records.description: A deep-indigo hero built around one oversized APY numeral, softened by an italic-serif counterphrase and a tilted phone mockup with a debit card layered behind it. Below, the page alternates dark and light full-bleed bands — proof stats, mirrored product cards with checklists, photo-based client stories, a dark Forbes pull-quote plus stat row, a light FAQ accordion — so the rhythm is set by background inversion rather than layout changes. Type scale is steep (display numeral ~120px down to 12px disclosures), depth comes from gradients and layered mockups rather than shadows, and the footer swells with regulatory fine print that reads as deliberate fintech credibility.

records.name: Wealthfront OG social card — "Money works better here." by wealthfront.com
records.description: A 1200×630 social card built on a single deep violet field with a radial bloom behind the headline and one large curved sweep crossing the lower third for depth. Hierarchy is strict: small white wordmark top-left, a dominant two-line headline mixing an ultra-bold grotesque ("Money works") with a high-contrast italic serif ("better here."), and a phone mockup tilted ~8° on the right whose white dashboard UI — balance figure, area chart, account list — is the only fine detail on the card. Everything else is negative space, with no CTA or supporting copy, which keeps the card legible at thumbnail size.

records.name: Wise brand-only social share card by wise.com
records.description: A 1200×630 brand-only share card: a flat field of Wise's bright lime green fills the whole canvas with no imagery, gradient or copy, and the dark forest-green wordmark — flag glyph plus lowercase 'wise' — sits alone at the optical centre. The card relies entirely on the two-colour brand pairing and heavy geometric letterforms, letting roughly 80% negative space make the mark the unmistakable focal point. It reads as a deliberate pause in a feed: bold, flat, instantly attributable, with no competing hierarchy beyond one centred lockup.

records.name: WorkID verified job board landing page by WorkID.ai
records.description: A centered, single-column landing page that alternates white sections with soft light-gray rounded panels to control pacing. Trust is the visual system: green 'Verified' chips, a 95-of-100 trust-score progress bar, and check-badged avatars, all demonstrated inside an annotated profile-card mockup rather than photography. Type is a single geometric sans with scale doing the work — a ~60px two-line hero, 36px section heads, 16px body — while a casual script face with hand-drawn arrows supplies the only decorative voice. Colour is disciplined: near-black text, one blue pill CTA repeated four times down the page, green reserved strictly for verification, black pills for secondary actions. Below the hero the rhythm tightens into utility — a search row with black button, three bordered job cards, a dotted Europe map scattered with avatar chips, a logo-pill grid ending in a skeleton 'your company could be here' chip — before a dense, functional footer with tagline, contact chip, three link columns and a small-print disclaimer.

records.name: WorkID og-image — verified hiring marketplace card by WorkID.ai
records.description: A 1200×630 social card that compresses an entire landing page into one frame. A centred blue rounded-square app icon with the wordmark anchors the top, two tilted white job-listing cards crop off the left and right edges to imply a live marketplace, and the focal point is the bold two-line headline 'Only verified employers. Only real candidates.' set in near-black geometric sans. Below it, a compact pill search bar, four pale-blue category tiles and cropped listing rows add product density over an ice-blue gradient, with mint 'New' tags and soft shadows providing the only extra colour.

records.name: WorkOS enterprise infrastructure landing page by workos.com
records.description: A spacious enterprise SaaS landing page uses a white canvas, oversized dark typography, and purple-to-blue gradient accents to establish hierarchy without visual clutter. The page moves from a compact hero and customer logo wall into alternating product capability sections, then shifts dramatically to a navy developer/API panel before returning to airy integration, admin, video, testimonial, and footer sections; soft shadows, pale lavender surfaces, rounded product mockups, and small line icons keep the technical content approachable.

records.name: WorkOS 'Your app, Enterprise Ready.' social card by workos.com
records.description: A 1200×630 share card built almost entirely from typography. The near-white canvas carries a faint diagonal diamond lattice that fades out on the left, keeping the text zone clean while adding texture to the empty right half. Hierarchy is handled by a two-line, left-aligned headline in a heavy grotesque: line one sits in solid near-black, line two runs purple-to-teal in a horizontal gradient, so the colour shift — not a size or weight change — marks the emphasis. A small logo-plus-wordmark lockup anchors the bottom-left like a signature, and the rest is deliberate negative space with no tagline, URL, or imagery competing for attention.

records.name: YNAB landing page by ynab.com
records.description: A personal-finance landing page that sells emotional relief, built on a cream canvas with indigo-to-purple gradient waves bookending it. The page pairs a chunky rounded serif display face with a neutral sans body, uses one loud lime-green CTA colour against navy ink, and changes rhythm down the page: dense hero with an illustrated phone and flying dollar bills, then an airy press strip, a 2×2 white stat grid with green baseline rules, a giant italic founder quote with blue highlighter marks, a three-step how-it-works beside an app collage, a hand-drawn arrow feeding into testimonial cards with wavy coloured bottoms, and finally a dark wave band CTA and navy footer. Organic shapes, doodle sparks and soft blobs keep the money topic friendly without a single stock photo.

records.name: YNAB open graph social card by ynab.com
records.description: A 1200×630 share card on a flat periwinkle-indigo field, split roughly 55/45 between a product visual and a headline column. The left cluster layers a simplified iPhone mockup — showing a believable app home screen with white rounded cards and lime amount pills — over an organic green blob, ringed with thin white and teal doodles (plus signs, sparkles, circles) that keep the flat background from feeling empty. The right column stacks a three-line rounded-bold headline in cream with a hand-drawn lime squiggle under the first word, a plain CTA line, and a cream wordmark with a green period pinned to the bottom-right corner. Hierarchy is carried almost entirely by scale and colour: cream-on-indigo for text, lime and teal reserved for accents and in-app money amounts.

records.name: Zola wedding planning landing page by zola.com
records.description: A warm, editorial consumer landing page that alternates a bright white top with a long deep-teal feature band. Hierarchy is carried by large serif headlines paired with rounded sans body text, and each feature row combines a real photo card with overlaid UI chips so product benefits feel tangible. Accent colours (lavender, pink, mint) rotate per section to keep the long scroll rhythmic without clutter. The page closes with a burgundy detail showcase, an advisor support section, an icon-grid vendor directory, and a link-rich footer.

records.name: Zola proposal-film Open Graph card by zola.com
records.description: A photography-only 1200×630 social card: a full-bleed, warm, film-like image of a garden proposal fills the entire canvas with no wordmark, headline or overlay. The composition does the branding work — the kneeling proposer and standing partner form a vertical focal axis slightly right of centre, framed by dark foliage on the left and soft white blossoms at the right edge for depth. Colour comes entirely from the scene: lush greens punctuated by a coral zigzag dress, with natural bokeh keeping edges soft. It reads as an editorial still rather than a marketing asset, letting the emotional moment carry recognition.
